html:
The Lotiga, also called Luthigh or Okara, were an Aboriginal Australian people of the western Cape York Peninsula in north Queensland. The map shows them from 1600 to 1800.

Very little is recorded about them. Their country lay among many small neighbouring peoples, including the Mpalitjanh, the Awngthim and the Mbeiwum, each with its own speech. Missions and cattle stations reached this coast in the late 1800s and early 1900s. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
